entities.name: State Museum of Victims of Repression in Tashkent
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Museum of Victims of Political Repression in Tashkent is a museum which tells the history of Uzbekistan during the political repression in the Soviet Union, in particular that of the people killed at that time.
